scripts.build: cd packages/tui && pnpm run build && cd ../ai && pnpm run build && cd ../agent && pnpm run build && cd ../webui && pnpm run build && cd ../coding-agent && pnpm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && pnpm run build && cd ../ai && pnpm run build:offline && cd ../agent && pnpm run build && cd ../webui && pnpm run build && cd ../coding-agent && pnpm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && pnpm run check:pinned-deps && pnpm run check:runtime-deps && pnpm run check:ts-imports && pnpm run check:entry-graphs && tsc --noEmit && pnpm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm -r run test
scripts.version:patch: pnpm -r exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:minor: pnpm -r exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:major: pnpm -r exec npm version major --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run check
